_note: Which card a quotation takes, when the mushaf cannot answer. Keyed by the quotation's own first line, verbatim — the same key the pipeline writes. The poem line is ayyuhal-walad's, hemistichs and all. BOTH DECLARATION FORMS are here on purpose: the bare word is schema v1 and every book on disk still uses it, and the object adds the speaker the card prints at the right of its header. A renderer that understood only one of them would fail here rather than in a book.
